[color=#8e7cc3][size=3]Processing Times Explanation:[/size][/color]

[spoiler][size=3]I chose the processing times based on how the vanilla game handles wine making. Each piece of jewelry's sell price is calculated by taking the sell price of the materials used to make it and multiplying that by 3, similar to wine making. (ex. a necklace made with Diamond and Iridium would sell for 10,500, since the material sell price combined would be 3,500). With crystalariums to duplicate diamonds, you could easily make a large amount of money quickly with this. Necklaces are worth the most, but you have to wait a whole season for them to finish. This way, it won't be an instant money hack early on and it should take similar preparation to wine making. There are config options to change the processing times![/size][/spoiler][/spoiler][/left]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/8Aduw8v.png[/img][/center][size=3][b]
Perfection None:[/b] None of the new jewelry is required for perfection.

[b]Perfection All:[/b] All new jewelry is required for perfection.

[b]Perfection Diamond:[/b] Only the Diamond variants of new jewelry is required for perfection. This is the default. 

[b]Processing Time Faster: [/b]Rings take 7 days to make, Earrings 10 days, and Necklaces 14 days

[b]Processing Time Fastest: [/b]Rings take 3 days to make, Earrings 5 days, and Necklaces 7 days

[color=#8e7cc3]My Recommendations: [/color]

[spoiler]I don't recommend using the Perfection All option because there are 120 new items, 370 if you have Sword and Sorcery, and the processing times are long if you have them on default. It's not impossible if you use multiple machines, but only use this option if you don't mind a challenge or don't have many other mods that add a bunch of new shippable items.[/spoiler]

[size=3]Q.) WHY HAS MY PERFECTION PROGRESS DISAPPEARED? HELP![/size]
[size=3][spoiler]It is very VERY important that when you update the mod you check to make sure your perfection settings are saved before loading into your save game. If your perfection settings were reverted to default and you play a full day of the game and it saves without you realizing, the perfection being reset is PERMANENT if you didn't have a back up save of some kind. So please, double check your settings while updating. Most of the time you can just drag the new update file into your folder and replace the existing files without deleting the original mod files, so that will keep your config options. I will specify on the file download if the update requires a completely fresh install![/spoiler]

Q.) I'm Getting Yellow Errors In SMAPI! Can You Fix Them?
[spoiler]All yellow errors should be fixed now! If you still have them, please make sure you're fully updated![/size][/spoiler]

[size=3]Q.) Is the jewelry wearable?[/size]
[size=3][spoiler]No, but I am toying with the idea of making Fashion Sense versions of the jewelry! But honestly, I figure the pixel art would be too small to really make any jewelry look unique and not just like a splash of gold or silver on the ears or neck. I'll attempt it when I add the things I definitely want to add first, but it might not turn out well so no promises![/spoiler][/size]

[size=3]Q.) Is the jewelry functional?[/size]
[size=3][spoiler]No, the jewelry you can make doesn't have any buffs like the rings you can get in game. BUT, it may not stay that way forever! This mod already wasn't meant to be as big as it is, and I'm afraid adding a whole enchantment mechanic to the jewelry would overcomplicate it for users. But I also know that I have the more is more mentality so I won't straight out say I'll never add the feature. Maybe I can add it as an optional file in the future, but I have a lot I want to do before that!﻿[/spoiler][/size]

[size=3]Q.) Can you change ____ about this mod? Can you add compatibility for ____ mod?[/size]
[size=3][spoiler]Maybe! I'm always open to suggestions so feel free to leave them in the comments! There's no absolute guarantee I'll do it, but I'm more likely to than not! Especially if the change can just be a config. I may have a config addiction. I just like to give people options. When it comes to compatibility with other mods, that honestly depends on how much I know about the mod and especially the mod author's permissions. But still, don't be afraid to make a suggestion![/spoiler][/size]

[size=3]Q.) Can I translate your mod?[/size]
[size=3][spoiler]Yes! Just make sure you make my mod a requirement, so just have your translation file up for download and not my whole mod along with it. You're allowed to earn Donation Points on your translation, so no need to give me the file! I want you to earn something from your work. Let me know if you translate my mod so I can add you to my Special Thanks! My PMs are open! <3[/spoiler][/size]
